title: CoRA-NAS: Coarse Ranking and Anchor-Residual Refinement for Neural Architecture Search
abstract: arXiv:2609.11884v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Zero-cost proxies rank architectures cheaply, but their reliability varies across search spaces. We introduce CoRA-NAS (COarse Ranking + Anchor-residual), a two-stage framework combining a static ranking prior with low-cost learning-curve refinement. CoRA-Rank aggregates capacity and structure-at-initialization proxies through an equal-weight log-rank consensus and a target-free consensus gate. CoRA-Refine samples anchors across this prior, extrapolates their early validation curves, and propagates a learned residual correction with an ExtraTrees model. The refinement uses approximately 1% of the cost of fully training the candidate set. Fully trained architecture-accuracy labels are not used to fit the ranker. One configuration is used across spaces, with space-specific architecture encodings. translated_title: CoRA-NAS：面向神经架构搜索的粗排序与锚点-残差精化方法
translated_abstract: 零成本代理能够以低成本对架构进行排序，但其可靠性在不同搜索空间之间差异较大。我们提出了CoRA-NAS（粗排序+锚点-残差），这是一个将静态排序先验与低成本学习曲线精化相结合的两阶段框架。CoRA-Rank通过等权对数秩共识和无目标共识门控，聚合容量类代理和初始化时结构类代理。CoRA-Refine在该先验上采样锚点架构，外推其早期验证曲线，并利用ExtraTrees模型传播学习到的残差校正。该精化过程仅使用完全训练候选集约1%的成本，且不使用任何完全训练的架构-准确率标签来拟合排序器。同一配置可跨搜索空间使用，仅需空间特定的架构编码。在NAS-Bench-201、NAS-Bench-101、TransNAS-Bench-101和NATS-SSS四个基准上，CoRA-Refine分别实现了0.946、0.715、0.786等平均Spearman相关系数。
tldr: CoRA-NAS提出了一种两阶段神经架构搜索框架，将零成本代理构成的静态粗排序先验与低成本锚点-残差学习曲线精化相结合，仅用约1%的完整训练成本和无准确率标签的方式，在多个搜索空间上实现了高可靠的架构性能排序。
en_tdlr: CoRA-NAS introduces a two-stage neural architecture search framework that combines a zero-cost proxy-based coarse ranking prior with low-cost anchor-residual learning-curve refinement, achieving reliable architecture performance ranking across multiple search spaces using only about 1% of full training cost without any trained accuracy labels.
